verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents transactional messaging as its own send type, triggered via a dedicated transactional API (App API) for receipts and password resets. That gives some evidence of a separate transactional path. Nothing in the pack shows separate suppression handling, delivery to unsubscribed contacts, or isolated sending reputation. Missing for 10: separate transactional templates, distinct suppression/unsubscribe bypass rules, separate sending reputation/IPs or streams, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, transactional email is kept separate from marketing — its own templates, suppression rules, and reputation — so a receipt still delivers to an unsubscribed contact

citations.quote: Transactional messages are ideal for: Purchase receipts, Registration confirmations, Password resets, Event reminders, Shipping updates
When someone does something that requires a transactional message, you’ll call our transactional API to send them a message—like when they request a password reset or need a receipt for a purchase.
To send broadcasts, transactional messages, and fetch data (outside of a _data out_ integration), use the App API.
